note: v1 94.67 (seeds 0/11 94.67/94.59), Glass Arithmetic: math rock with mallets at 150 bpm. Every bar an additive grouping of 2s and 3s (5-13 eighths); kick and bass on each group start, snare on the last. A 5-note tapped loop (starcaster-clean, sixteenths) and a 7-note loop (clean-dry, eighths) braid across the bar lines; hats in dotted eighths; the marimba tune walks the chord. Half-time B, a 3+2 breakdown, a build that grows by one 3 a bar, the last return a whole step up. Drafts: 82.66 (flat dynamics, all on the eighth grid) -> 87.85 (dynamics lane, EQ to the genre envelope) -> 89.84 (dotted hats) -> 94.67.

v2 96.80 (seeds 0/11 96.80/96.69 vs v1 94.67/94.59): GHOST PICK-UPS - a soft snare on the sixteenth before each group start (bar's first excepted) wherever the band taps, so every grouping is pushed in from the sixteenth: rhythm 75 -> 93 (off-grid share .06 -> ~.1).

v3 97.69 (seeds 0/11 97.69/97.64 vs v2 re-scored 96.82): the master EQ against the genre envelope - v2's highshelf overshot (+9.6 dB at 15 kHz) and the lows sat 7-8 dB under at 38-182 Hz with +6-7 dB at 1.2-1.4 kHz: lowshelf 150 Hz +8, peak 1.3 kHz -4, a 7 kHz +5 peak in place of the shelf, highshelf 12 kHz -5 (spectrum 91 -> 100). barvariety 97 (detail).

v4 98.72 (seeds 0/11 98.72/98.71 vs v3 97.69): the half-time marimba section (B) takes the dotted-eighth hats too (sixteenths accented every third, under the half-time kick and snare), so the floating section still pulls across the grid: rhythm 92.6 -> 100 (off-grid share .09 -> over .1), barvariety 97.7 -> 100.

v5 98.71 kept (seeds 0/11 98.71/98.71 vs v4 98.72/98.71): two new events in the form. A TAPPED SOLO (new section S, 8 bars after the marimba's B): the left guitar breaks out of its 5-loop into two-octave tapping shapes in sixteenths, one shape per group of each bar's grouping, widening bar by bar and leaping an octave for the last two, with a 3/16 echo; the right guitar lays out so the solo stands alone over bass and kit. THE STOP: the build's last bar is one unison hit and a bar of air, so the whole-step-up return lands like a door opening.

v6 98.70 (seeds 0/11 98.70/98.70 vs v5 98.71/98.71): A2 becomes a DIALOGUE. After the tapped solo, the soloist stays on and talks with the marimba over the braid in 2-bar turns: the guitar calls with a short tapping shape (the bar's first two groups, then air), and the marimba answers the next bar with the same notes at half speed, turned upside down around its first note every other time, so each answer bends the question. The return after the solo now carries the solo's thread instead of resetting.

v7 98.70 (seeds 0/11 98.70/98.70, level with v6): GLASS on the last return. When the song steps up a whole tone for A3, a glockenspiel joins an octave above the marimba's dotted line, striking only the first note of each group of the bar's grouping. The sparkle traces the grouping row in the top register, so the key change gets a new colour and the 2s and 3s become audible as a melody of accents.
